note: Ordered steps per trophy, written in this entry's own words. Every step cites its sources by key (EXO = Exophase official list, PSNP = PSNProfiles trophy list, PSN = the official PlayStation description, OWN = this guide's own reading of the official description). estMin is this guide's own estimate in minutes; a step marked estimate=true is not pinned down by any source and is labelled as a guess, never as fact.

1.text: Earn the other 54 trophies first — the platinum has no step of its own and unlocks the moment the last one lands.
Work the roadmap in order: story (Stage 1), strands (Stage 2), collectibles (Stage 3), activities (Stage 4), crime/money (Stage 5), then the 100% cleanup (Stage 6).
Check the Statistics page before the finale: any counted trophy below its target is cheaper to finish before the last mission than after it.

10.text: Reach the Child's Play mission in campaign order.
Complete the mission; the trophy fires on completion.

11.text: Reach the Headliners mission in campaign order.
Complete the mission; the trophy fires on completion.

12.text: Reach the VCIA Takedown mission in campaign order.
While at VCIA for this mission, attempt Catch Me If You Can (unscheduled departure) — its window may be tied to story access here.
Complete VCIA Takedown; the trophy fires on completion.

13.text: Reach the Operation Savage Glory mission in campaign order.
Complete the mission; the trophy fires on completion.

14.text: Treat this as the master checklist: every counted trophy on this list feeds the 100% total.
Finish the story, all stranger strands, all collectible sets and all activity counters before the cleanup phase.
Use the Statistics page to find the last missing percentages, then close them one by one; the gold fires at 100%.

15.text: Stunt whenever you travel — jumps, drifts and airtime all count toward the 250 total; do not save it for the end.
Count stunts in the tracker; the last 50 are the only ones worth a dedicated session.

16.text: Sample the activity types as they unlock: races, ranges, drone courses, fishing, arcade, bowling and the rest (9 in total).
One attempt at each type is enough — mastery belongs to the counted trophies, not this one.

17.text: Visit the Shooting Ranges as they open; golds are needed in all 42 challenges, and the same golds sit on the 100% checklist.
Work the easier tiers first to learn each challenge's scoring, then return for the hardest golds.
Note the live dispute: published guides disagree on how the 42 golds split across venues — the total of 42 is what the official tracking counts.

18.text: Find the Top Fun drone courses — 14 locations, one win each.
Win a race at each location and tick it off in the tracker so the last missing course is easy to find.

19.text: Race across the list — 20 different races must be won, so re-winning a favourite adds nothing.
Alternate race types to keep the counter climbing and to sample activity types for Master of None.

2.text: Start a new campaign; Gone Fishing is the opening mission.
Play through the mission to its end — no side condition is attached to this trophy in the official list.

20.text: Take the fishing challenge against Cal when it is offered.
Beat Cal once — a single head-to-head win, not a grind.

3.text: Play Chapter 1's missions in order; the trophy fires on chapter completion, not on any single mission.
Bank early counted progress on the way (stunts, vehicle discoveries) instead of backtracking later.

4.text: Play Chapter 2's missions in order; the trophy fires on chapter completion.
Start any stranger strands that appear in this chapter — strands count toward the 8-strand silver.

5.text: Play Chapter 3's missions in order; the trophy fires on chapter completion.
Keep the counted counters climbing with normal travel (stunts, WAiNK, meditation spots) rather than saving them for cleanup.

6.text: Play Chapter 4's missions in order; the trophy fires on chapter completion.
Before the chapter ends, clear the partner one-offs (Hot Together, Retail Therapy) — the partner may not be available later.

7.text: Finish Chapters 1–4 and the named missions first; the final mission is the last story step.
Before starting the finale, sweep the Missable Watch list — the official list promises no post-ending free roam.
Complete the final mission; the gold fires on completion.

8.text: Reach the Breakfast Run mission in campaign order.
Complete the mission; the trophy fires on completion with no side condition in the official list.

9.text: Reach The Cartel Heist mission in campaign order.
Complete the mission; the trophy fires on completion.

21.text: Find an arcade and start a game.
Complete the game to its end — one full completion, and it also counts as an activity type for Master of None.

22.text: Start Andy's strand when his missions appear; do not leave strands for the endgame.
Work Andy's missions through to the final one.
Complete Andy's final mission — it also counts toward the 8-strand silver.

23.text: Start Kenton's strand when his missions appear.
Work Kenton's missions through to the final one.
Complete Kenton's final mission — it also counts toward the 8-strand silver.

24.text: Start Billy's strand when his missions appear.
Work Billy's missions through to the final one.
Complete Billy's final mission — it also counts toward the 8-strand silver.

25.text: Open stranger strands as they appear across Leonida — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret are the named ones on this list.
Finish 8 strands fully; opening many and closing none adds nothing to the counter.

26.text: Start Randy's strand when his missions appear.
Work Randy's missions through to the final one.
Complete Randy's final mission — it also counts toward the 8-strand silver.

27.text: Start Tyrone's strand when his missions appear.
Work Tyrone's missions through to the final one.
Complete Tyrone's final mission — it also counts toward the 8-strand silver.

28.text: Find the meditation spots across Leonida — 18 in total.
Fold the sweep into the 52-area exploration: each district trip banks meditation spots and area discovery together.

29.text: Start Bret's strand when his missions appear.
Take the hunt for the unique animal when Bret asks for it.
Finish the hunt before treating Bret's strand as done — its window is tied to the strand.

30.text: Collect cards across Leonida, keeping sets together — loose cards from many sets finish nothing.
Complete 3 full sets; count sets, not loose cards, in the tracker.

31.text: Use WAiNK at locations as you travel — the 100 accumulate as a by-product of trips you already owe.
Pair the sweep with meditation spots and area discovery so every district trip banks three counters at once.

32.text: Work the challenge list, preferring challenges that overlap other counters (races, ranges, stunts) so each completion pays twice.
Count challenges in the tracker; the 50th fires the trophy.

33.text: With your partner beside you, raise a 4-star wanted level.
Lose the wanted level and escape the heat — both halves are required.
Do it during the campaign while the partner is with you; the official list gives no post-story promise.

34.text: With your partner, pick a row of three nearby shops.
Rob all three back-to-back, keeping the wanted level alive between shops — do not break the heat in between.

35.text: Swap vehicles as you travel instead of keeping one favourite — variety is the whole job.
Register each new discovery in the Scooter Bros app too, so Whip It Good and On the Spot climb together.

36.text: Save Combat Focus for a crowded fight, not for one or two targets.
Activate Focus and take down 5 enemies inside that single activation.

37.text: Get to VCIA — story access comes with the VCIA Takedown mission.
Make an unscheduled departure: leave the airport in a way the schedule never planned.
Try it while the mission puts you at VCIA rather than assuming free-roam access later.

38.text: No settled step exists: the official description only jokes about Rhinos (the game's tanks) and pins down no exact action.
Honest position — expect a Rhino encounter and try surviving it, riding in one, or destroying one; published guides debate which, and this guide states none as fact.

39.text: Plan the quiet entry and exit of a jewelry store before touching anything.
Rob the store without being detected — the whole attempt is the stealth condition.
If you are spotted, restart the attempt rather than finishing it loud; a loud robbery banks nothing.

40.text: Find bank vaults and plan the escape route before going in — the escape is part of every one of the five.
Rob 5 vaults, escaping after each; count vaults in the tracker.

41.text: Find an armored truck on the road.
Rob the truck and escape — a single successful job, escape included.

42.text: Travel Leonida district by district — 52 areas in total.
Bank meditation spots, WAiNK locations and vehicle discoveries on every district trip so the sweep pays four counters at once.

43.text: Find the gangs' illegal operations — one per gang, 9 gangs in total.
Rob one operation from each gang; track gangs, not robberies — a second operation from the same gang adds nothing.

44.text: Go to Ocean Beach — the one trophy whose official description names its place outright.
Enjoy a cocktail with the view. Do it on your first Ocean Beach visit and bank it early.

45.text: Enter a vehicle showroom and take a car.
Drive the car out through the frontage, smashing through the glass in classic style — the description's own wording, read as the step.

46.text: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Bowl there — the follow-through at that named alley is the trophy, and bowling also counts as an activity type.

47.text: No settled step exists: the official description — 'A partnership with mass appeal' — names no action, place or count.
Honest position — a partner-themed one-off whose exact trigger published sources have not yet agreed on; this guide invents no step for it.

48.text: Make choices as you play — PlayStation tracks this to 500, so it fills across a full playthrough.
If it lags late, favour choice-heavy interactions over free roam; it is a long-tail counter, not a single action to hunt.

49.text: No settled step exists: 'Second time's the charm' implies succeeding on a second attempt after a first failure, but names neither the activity nor the place.
Honest position — no sourced trigger yet; retrying failed activities is the only reading the description supports, and this guide invents none.

50.text: No settled step exists: 'What the hell just happened?' points at witnessing something strange, with no place or trigger stated.
Honest position — treat it as a scripted-strangeness trophy you meet by playing, not a location to camp; no sourced pinpoint exists yet.

51.text: Find a pedestrian target on a road you can drive past.
Strike the target with a melee attack from the moving vehicle — a drive-by, not a crash.

52.text: Route Marked Bills to your contacts as a habit, not a finale — the quarter-million accumulates across the campaign's crime work.
Count the laundered total in the tracker; the $250,000th dollar fires the trophy.

53.text: Buy as you go across all shops — the $100,000 fills naturally if you spend during the campaign.
If it lags late, it is one of the safest final grinds: spending is always available.

54.text: Keep enough cash unspent late in the run — 8 garage properties must be bought.
Purchase each garage and count properties in the tracker as each purchase lands.

55.text: Open the Scooter Bros app and register a vehicle you discovered.
Register 10 vehicles in total — pair it with Whip It Good: every new discovery is a registration candidate.
